name: turn_on_light
description: Turn on or adjust lights in a specified room. Example: 'dim the living room light to 50%' -> room='living room', brightness=50. 中文示例: '客厅灯开到50%' -> room='客厅', brightness=50

room.description: Room name, e.g. 'living room', '客厅'. Extract the specific room from the command.

name: set_thermostat
description: Set the thermostat temperature. Example: 'set AC to 26 degrees' -> temperature=26. 中文示例: '空调调到26度' -> temperature=26

temperature.description: Target temperature in Celsius (°C). Default range 16-30°C.

mode.description: AC mode: cool (cooling/制冷), heat (heating/制热), auto (automatic/自动).
